caption: The drawing consists of six rectangular swatches arranged in two columns and three rows on a plain beige background. In the top left rectangle, there is a green and white plaid pattern intersected with dashed lines in red and black. The top right rectangle displays a solid blue field with white floral and leaf-like motifs located in the corners. The middle left rectangle has a black background filled with clusters of small green dots and circular shapes with tan centers and white peripheries. In the middle right rectangle, there is a bright yellow background decorated with small red star-like flowers and thin, scattered black stems and leaves. The bottom left rectangle features a white background with a pattern of small, blue floral designs connected by thin blue stems. The bottom right rectangle displays a series of horizontal stripes in black, brown, tan, and reddish-pink, with some of the stripes containing diagonal hatching.
title: Quilt Patches
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
